description: We are a team participating in the Sohag Local Event for NASA Space Apps 2026. Our goal is to create an engaging Mobile App/Game about Mars. We blend space data with gamification to make learning fun. We have ideas for design and storytelling, and we need teammates for coding and graphic design to bring this game to life! Join us!
summary:
The name of our project is Astro Gamers, which involves an interactive, voiceover-narrated, educational web-based game. Our project is aimed at dealing with the problem of teaching kids about the tools, rovers, and equipment left by NASA on the Moon and on Mars. Rather than delivering such information in the form of articles, we decided to make a game out of it.

Our project is significant in that children are naturally inclined to games rather than to articles. By means of combining the elements of gamification with audio elements, we managed to make the study of NASA's history of space exploration interesting and entertaining. With the help of voiceover, even younger children will be able to join the process and learn scientific facts easily.
details:
What it does and How it works:

Space Relics is an interactive online educational game that helps kids learn about the Moon and Mars and the gadgets left behind by NASA. Users play the game and interact with various space gadgets. In our game, we have included a voiceover facility so that the game can speak directly to users by narrating facts and making the learning process more interactive.

Benefits and Target Impact:

The main benefit of our game is the ability to transform complicated space information into a fun learning process. With the inclusion of audio narration, even kids who are not old enough to learn to read can take advantage of the game. It enhances the retention of information through auditory and visual processes. The target impact of our game is to raise interest in space exploration among future generations of astronauts and scientists.

Creativity & Innovation:

The creativity of our project is in that it transforms space education from merely reading about it into playing with it. This is done through integration of the real world space knowledge with gaming elements and narration. In the process, kids learn through sight and hearing without necessarily knowing that they are learning.

Considered Factors (Accessibility & Cost):

Accessibility: Space Relics was created in the form of a web application that is available on all devices with access to the Internet. Most importantly, the feature of voiceover was included in the project in order to make sure that the game could be used by young kids who cannot read.

Cost: The game is free of charge.

GitHub Repository: You can check the complete source code and structure of our project on GitHub: https://github.com/mariammoustafa-lab/Astro-Gamers.git
